_meta.description: Hypothesis register. Each hypothesis states a falsifiable prediction, the exact test executed, and the verbatim evidence returned. 'supported'/'refuted' describe the evidence gathered in this session only.
_meta.reverification_note: 2026-09-16 second pass: every source_id cited by the register was re-fetched live; no verdict changed. H4/H5 rank-1 anchor ($2,303,725 at +921.49%) confirmed unchanged on the live leaderboard.

hypotheses.claim: Returns of >=10x on the paper account are achievable in The Leap and have been officially recorded.
hypotheses.prediction: At least one completed edition has a published #1 net profit >= 900%.
hypotheses.test: Count records in data/verified_explosive_returns.json with return_multiple >= 10.
evidence: Futures - February 2025, BenBernanke1, +5,220.72% (53.2072x), 59,187 participants
AMP Futures - September 2026, leonardo22_romano, +921.49% (10.2149x), in progress, 92,364 participants

hypotheses.claim: The route to >=10x in The Leap is leveraged futures, not single stocks.
hypotheses.prediction: Every verified >=10x case is a futures edition; stocks editions top out far below 2x.
hypotheses.test: Group verified records by asset_class_label and compare best_multiple per class.
evidence: Both verified >=10x cases are futures editions.
Stocks editions (n=2): best 1.299x (+29.90%, Dec 2025), worst 1.1758x (+17.58%, Mar 2026) - the LOWEST winning returns of any class.
Futures editions (n=6): best 53.2072x, worst 2.1192x.
Live contest rules: 'Leverage for futures: 20:1'

hypotheses.claim: The live (September 2026) contest permits trading single stocks.
hypotheses.prediction: The permitted instrument list contains at least one NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX single-stock contract.
hypotheses.test: Parse data/contest_universe.json and count instruments whose exchange is an equity venue.
evidence: 94 instruments in the permitted list. Exchange breakdown: CBOT 17, CBOT_MINI 15, CME 24, CME_MINI 18, COMEX 5, COMEX_MINI 6, NYMEX 7, NYMEX_MINI 2. Equity instruments: 0.

hypotheses.claim: The most volatile underlying is automatically the best instrument to trade for leaderboard rank.
hypotheses.prediction: The instruments with the highest per-unit volatility also have the largest achievable absolute $ P/L.
hypotheses.test: For instruments with a verified contract multiplier, compute max_underlying_exposure = position cap x multiplier, then the underlying price move needed to reach the current rank-1 P/L.
evidence: CME:SOL1! is capped at 1 contract = 500 SOL. Reaching the current rank-1 P/L of $2,303,725 requires a $4,607.45 per-SOL move.
CME:MSL1! is capped at 5 contracts = 125 SOL, requiring an $18,429.80 per-SOL move.
CME:XRP1! is capped at 1 contract = 50,000 XRP, requiring a $46.07 per-XRP move.
CME:MXP1! is capped at 5 contracts = 12,500 XRP, requiring a $184.30 per-XRP move.
Conclusion: position caps, not per-unit volatility, bind absolute P/L.

hypotheses.claim: Ranking is by absolute realized profit in USD, so notional capacity matters more than percentage return.
hypotheses.prediction: The rules define the ranking metric as realized profit/loss on closed positions, and the leaderboard publishes an absolute $ column.
hypotheses.test: Read the ranking clause in the rules and the leaderboard column headers.
evidence: Rules: 'A participant's place ... is determined based on the realized profit/loss on the Competition account.'
Rules: 'Realized profit/loss for the purposes of the Competition is considered to be profit/loss on closed positions.'
Leaderboard columns as served: 'Realized profit %' AND 'Realized profit $'.
Arithmetic check: rank 1 published as +921.49% and +$2,303,725.00; 250,000 x 9.2149 = 2,303,725.00, an exact match, confirming the $250,000 base.

hypotheses.claim: A 100x return has been verified in The Leap.
hypotheses.prediction: At least one official record shows return_multiple >= 100.
evidence: 0 verified cases at or above 100x across all 16 sourced records.
The single highest verified outcome is 53.2072x (Futures - February 2025).

hypotheses.claim: Contest parameters are stable across editions, so a strategy tuned once carries over.
hypotheses.prediction: Balance, leverage, position caps and commission are identical between consecutive futures editions.
hypotheses.test: Diff the TradeStation Jul 2026 rules against the AMP Futures Sep 2026 rules.
evidence: Balance 100,000 -> 250,000 virtual USD (2.5x).
Futures leverage 10:1 -> 20:1 (2x); max notional 1,000,000 -> 5,000,000 (5x).
NYMEX:CL1! position cap 1.0 -> 100.0 contracts (100x).
CME:MBT1! position cap 5.0 -> 25.0 contracts (5x).
Prize-paying ranks 250 -> 300.

hypotheses.claim: A free-plan account can compete on equal terms in the live edition.
hypotheses.prediction: Free-plan participants receive the same market data as paid participants.
hypotheses.test: Read the real-time data clause (section 06) of the live rules.
evidence: Rules: free-plan users 'who were not previously active users of TradingView's paid services will not be provided with the Competition Real-Time Data by reason of their participation in the Competition.'
Rules: after subscribing, 'access to the Competition Real-Time Data will then be granted within twenty-four (24) hours'.
They may register and are prize-eligible, but they trade without competition real-time data unless they subscribe or trial.

hypotheses.claim: Maximum deployable notional in the live edition is $5,000,000.
hypotheses.test: Arithmetic on two verified constants from the rules.
evidence: 'The preset balance size for the Paper Trading Competition Account is 250,000 virtual USD. Leverage for futures: 20:1.'
Corollary (computed): an adverse move of 250,000 / 5,000,000 = 5.00% on fully deployed notional equals the entire balance. Equivalently 1/20 = 5%, the inverse of the stated leverage.

hypotheses.claim: Mid-contest prize-tier entry thresholds of the live edition are far below rank 1: roughly +441% for the top 50, +352% for the top 100 and +228% for the top 250 (day ~16 snapshot).
hypotheses.prediction: If rank thresholds scale smoothly, the top-50 boundary should be near half the rank-1 return and the top-250 boundary near a quarter.
hypotheses.test: Read the verified deep-leaderboard snapshot rows: rank 50 (last $400 tier), rank 100, rank 250 (last displayed row).
evidence: Rank 50 nikhilln143 +441.44% +$1,103,610.00 (last row of the $400 prize tier; rank 51 NOESIS_CAPITAL +437.39%).
Rank 250 Dip_Dey +228.14% +$570,345.80 (last displayed row of the public leaderboard).
Boundary rows: rank 25 ashutoshrajan6 +537.91% is the last $550 tier; rank 26 RogueTrader84 +537.20% the first $400 tier.
All figures are a day ~16 snapshot of a 30-day contest; final thresholds will differ (see H12 and past-edition records).

hypotheses.claim: The leaderboard's displayed $ profit equals 250,000 x (displayed %)/100 up to the rounding of the percentage to two decimals — the % and $ columns are one number, not two.
hypotheses.prediction: Every displayed $ should lie within $12.50 of 250,000 x pct/100 (max rounding error of a 2-decimal % on a $250,000 base).
hypotheses.test: Recompute for all captured rows with both columns: rank 1, 2, 50, 100, 250.
evidence: All diffs <= $12.50 = 250,000 x 0.005%, the exact bound implied by 2-decimal % rounding.

hypotheses.claim: Winning thresholds are edition-specific, not universal: futures editions demand ~10x+ at the top while stocks editions have been won with under 1.2x, so asset class determines the required return more than any fixed 'win number'.
hypotheses.prediction: A completed stocks edition should show a #1 return an order of magnitude below futures editions.
hypotheses.test: Compare the verified #1 records across editions: CME futures edition 53.2072x (BenBernanke1, official blog + landing page), live futures edition day ~16 rank 1 10.2149x, stocks 'Magnificent Seven' March 2026 final #1 +17.58% (1.1758x).
evidence: Magnificent Seven (stocks, March 2026, COMPLETED): 1st place prodigy5284 +17.58% +$17,576.05 — 41,301 participants, 19 days.
The Leap by CME (futures, ended March 2025): winner BenBernanke1, official blog announcement, with the 53.2072x net-profit record displayed on the landing page.
AMP Futures September 2026 (futures, live): rank 1 leonardo22_romano +921.49% (10.2149x) at day ~16 of 30.
Ratio of best futures #1 to best stocks #1: 53.2072x / 1.1758x ≈ 45x.
